text: {"name":"ps_disable_cfm_handler","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Logs a PS-disable confirmation and, when the shared pending count reaches zero, clears eligible list-entry flags and sends completion message 50 to the configured task.","subsystem":"mm","struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"linked-record next pointer"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"linked-record state flags; bits 1–3 are cleared for eligible records"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"shared pending-confirmation count, decremented before final cleanup"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"record state byte; records are processed only when zero"},{"offset":108,"meaning":"secondary record state byte; must be nonzero to clear the flags"},{"offset":0,"meaning":"completion-state byte reset before sending the message"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"destination task identifier used for completion message 50"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"list descriptor’s head pointer"}]}
